response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM counts), above AS (SELECT c.account_id, c.cnt, c.cnt - o.avg_cnt AS diff_overall FROM counts c CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE c.cnt > o.avg_cnt), above_avg AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_above FROM above) SELECT a.account_id, a.cnt AS order_count, a.diff_overall AS above_overall_avg, a.cnt - b.avg_above AS above_group_avg_diff FROM above a CROSS JOIN above_avg b ORDER BY above_group_avg_diff DESC LIMIT 10;
